items.evidence: Financial results (Earnings, Cash flow, Divestiture proceeds) is one of four CIP categories weighted 40%
Earnings —2020 reported earnings of -$5.5 billion were significantly below Plan
Cash flow —Chevron delivered operating cash flow of $10.6 billion in 2020, significantly below Plan.
Divestiture proceeds —$2.9 billion in asset sales proceeds were realized for the year.
Capital management | 30% | Return on capital employed (4)(5)
Return on capital employed —Reported ROCE for 2020 of -2.8 percent was below Plan
Capital and exploratory expenditures —2020 organic C&E totaled $13.1 billion, significantly better than and exceeded
Major milestones per Plan: Tengizchevroil FGP/WPMP —Achieved milestones for module fabrication
Operating performance | 15% | Net production, excluding impact of divestments
Net production —3.131 million barrels of oil-equivalent per day in 2020, excluding divestments.
Operating expense —$25.4 billion, slightly better than Plan. Severance charges mostly offset cost savings in 2020.
Refining utilization —Rates were intentionally below Plan by 10.6 percentage points
Health, environmental, and safety | 15% | Personal safety (4,7,8)
Personal safety —Industry-leading Total Recordable Incident rate and matched record low Serious Injury count
Process safety and environmental —Achieved record low with zero Severe Tier 1 incident count for the Company.
Greenhouse gas management —On-track to achieve oil, gas, flaring, and methane intensity reductions.
The MCC continues to believe TSR should be the primary overall pay-for-performance measure
Added a second LTIP performance share metric, Relative ROCE Improvement – linking LTIP to our focus on delivering higher returns.
